messages:
anika: FYI deploybot tried to unpin runtime-3.2 in eu-west canary and it was blocked by a pinlist rule, we're seeing 502 spikes. Anyone on call can triage?

deploybot: SYSTEM: unpin attempt failed.
```
unpin_attempt: runtime-3.2
region: eu-west
status: blocked
reason: sticky-pin-detected
id: attempt-1751122334
```

sasha: I pulled a few traces. There's a tight loop of kernel fallback + KV cache thrashing when sdk v1.9 talks to quantized paths in 3.2 under longseq traffic. Looks reproducible in the canary trace samples.

mike: If the unpin is blocked we should abort the unpin and roll back the canary to runtime-3.1 to stop the errors. Recommend a 10m rollback window. @eng-runtime please confirm readiness.

ops_bot: RUNBOOK SUGGESTION:
1) apply route override -> runtime-3.1 for eu-west canary cohort
2) scale down new runtime-3.2 pods and drain gracefully
3) monitor /svc/runtime/canary/error_rate and /svc/runtime/canary/latency every 30s for 10m
4) open pager if error_rate > 1% for 3 consecutive samples

elia: ack. Preparing rollback play. I'll also draft the short release note addendum and a pinlist exception rationale. If deploybot retries unpin after 180s, we execute rollback immediately.

anika: Action item list: @mike trigger rollback, @sasha run a quick sdk fallback test matrix vs runtime-3.2, @deploybot pause auto-unpin attempts. I'll post status updates every 2m.

mike: Starting rollback now. deploybot, run rollback rb-1751122334.

deploybot: ACTION: rollback requested.
```
rollback_id: rb-1751122334
target: runtime-3.1
region: eu-west
hosts_affected: 18
eta_seconds: 300
status: in_progress
```

sasha: Traffic shifting. We saw a small latency bump during KV warmup ~450ms but 502s dropped to zero after the switch.

ops_bot: WARNING: expect transient latency up to 600ms during cache warmup. Alert threshold at 500ms for >2m.

anika: Noted. Postmortem items: add canary CI test pairing runtime-3.2 (quant kernels) with sdk v1.9 under longseq load; add sticky-pin detection to preflight checks; and update pinlist docs to clarify kernel/SDK combos.

mike: I'll file the pinlist exception entry and block future auto-unpins until the CI test lands. Drafting rollback note for release notes now.

deploybot: COMPLETED: rollback rb-1751122334 succeeded. All eu-west canary instances now on runtime-3.1. No unpin locks remain.

anika: Thanks team. Closing after PRs for the CI test and pinlist policy update are opened. Filing follow-up ticket: ENG-compat-1751122334 for the test + policy changes.
